utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: The repair drive is Sunday at the community center, and I can help with the easiest route if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Jules — Sunday at the community center works. I’ll pass that along and send Rosa any homes that need help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great — thanks, Leo. If Rosa or anyone else needs the route or details, send them my way and I’ll help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m checking our supplies now and setting aside what we can spare. Once I know what’s missing, I’ll tell you the biggest gap.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Cleo — what’s the biggest gap so far? I’ve only heard bits, so I’m trying to figure out what they need first.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m still confirming the list, but the biggest gap looks like the easiest fix once I finish checking our supplies. I’ll let you know as soon as I’ve got it pinned down.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll pass along the location and what to bring once you send it over.

utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — please send me the homes that need repairs and any missing supplies, and I’ll keep the updated details moving.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll send over the homes that need repairs and any missing supplies now.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — I’ll organize the updates and keep everyone posted on where to help at the community center Sunday.

utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Mina — can you send me the repair drive location and the best route there?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — it’s the community center on Maple, and the easiest route is to take 8th over to Birch, then head north. Want me to text you the exact address too?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, please text the exact address too — thanks, Mina.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word and point you to the repair drive details.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds good — send me anything still missing, and I’ll keep spreading the repair drive details to the neighbors.

utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple, Oren—please send me the repair list first, and I’ll sort it by priority.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure — I’ll send over the repair list right now, and you can sort it by priority. If I miss anything, just flag it for me.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Perfect, Oren — send it over and I’ll sort it by priority. If anything looks missing, I’ll flag it right away.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and help recruit neighbors for Sunday’s repair drive. Send me any details I should pass along.

utterances.speaker: Kira

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes — I’ll help recruit neighbors for Sunday’s repair drive. Send me any details you want me to share.

utterances.speaker: Gus

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus — I’ll be ready when you swing by for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You’re welcome, Noah — I’ll be there soon with the wrench and screwdriver.

utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Faye — that covers the details I needed. I appreciate you confirming the time, drop-off spot, and bring list for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course — I’ll send the final details along and keep an eye out if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Hana

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yep—just send me the start time and any tool list, and I’ll be there ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it — I’ll pass along that we still need the start time and a tool list. If I hear anything else while I’m out, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Still nothing new on the repair drive, but I’m keeping an ear out and I’ll pass it along as soon as I hear. If Bo needs anything, just let me know and I’ll share it along.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Tess — just keep me posted, and I can help with whatever’s quickest.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You got it — I’ll keep you posted and pass along anything I hear. If something quick comes up for the repair drive, I’ll send it your way.

utterances.speaker: Jules

utterances.speaker: Jules

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Pia — I’m still coordinating around the school schedule. What time works best for you for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’d need the time from Rosa before I can lock anything in. Once that’s set, I can work around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Got it — I’ll wait for Rosa’s time and then I’ll fit it around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces, so I’m still piecing it together—do Rosa and Ira have the time pinned down? And do you know what they’re planning to fix first?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — the repair drive is set for Sunday at the community center, and I’m keeping the details updated as we go. If you hear of any homes that need help, send them my way and I’ll add them to the list.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — Sunday at the community center, got it. Have you heard what they’re planning to fix first?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Rey, any update on the repair drive? I’m out running errands, so I can pass it along if anything’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Rey

utterances.speaker: Ira

utterances.speaker: Quinn

utterances.speaker: Bo

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Quick version: I’m still helping, and I’ll keep rounding up neighbors and supplies for the repair drive this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Tess — I’ll be ready once you hear back.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — keep me posted on the timing, and I’ll update you once I’ve checked what supplies we can spare.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll let everyone know as soon as I have the time and coordinator, and I’ll keep the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — can you confirm the time and who’s coordinating? I’ll double-check the rest and keep the repair drive on track.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It’s still Saturday morning, and I’m pretty sure Ira’s coordinating the logistics. What should I bring for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great — please bring any basic tools, tape, and labels if you can. I’ll confirm with Ira and double-check the setup details.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
